name: Phoenix Dance Vehicle
description: During the prosperous period of the Tang Dynasty, singing and dancing flourished, and both music, dance, and art paintings reached a new height. From the Jinghong Dance to the Dunhuang murals, they all praise the prosperity of the Tang Dynasty, and the flower-drum carts parading in the streets of the Tang Dynasty are filled with the joy of the people of the Tang Dynasty and spread throughout the city of Chang'an. Pinku integrates the singing and dancing, murals and float art of the Tang Dynasty to create a stunning drum car in the prosperous Tang Dynasty, once again interpreting the beauty of the prosperous age.
